caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The pitcher is tan in color with brown painted decorations, including a series of oval, curved, and wavy patterns around the upper and mid-sections of the vessel. The pitcher has a wide body, a narrower neck, a rounded lip, and a single handle attached from the upper neck to the shoulder. The interior of the pitcher is shown as dark brown, and there are darker brown notes on the spout, handle, and bottom portion. The drawing is signed below the pitcher, near the center-bottom of the image, with the name "S. Jordan." There are no additional objects, and the rest of the composition is left blank.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
